# Towards Data Engineering

Towards Data Engineering is a Medium publication on data engineering, cloud architecture, agentic AI, and MLOps. The publication features practical stories from data engineers working on real systems. Edited by Aman Ranjan Verma, it serves a community of practitioners building and operating data platforms at scale.

## Pages

- Home: https://tde.arverma.dev/ - About the publication, latest stories, and writer request form
- FAQs: https://tde.arverma.dev/faqs.html - Frequently asked questions about writing for TDE
- Editors: https://tde.arverma.dev/editors.html - Information for editors and how to join the editorial team
- Partner Policy: https://tde.arverma.dev/partner-policy.html - Guidelines for partnerships and collaborations
- Medium publication: https://medium.com/towards-data-engineering - The full publication with all stories

## About the editor

Aman Ranjan Verma is a senior data engineer at QuillBot with 7+ years building data and AI platforms. He edits Towards Data Engineering and writes about data engineering, Apache Iceberg, Kafka, and data platforms.
